The task

A capture needs preparation and cleanup before it can be used on a character. The goal is to work on an isolated capture rig while preserving the original skeleton, Actions and NLA tracks.

The approach

The helper prepares Mixamo-compatible rigs and character presets, then lets you preview manual adjustments to the root, torso, hands, pelvis and feet against the source take.

In use

Transfer the take into a separate Action or NLA strip on the original rig, or build an editable corrected Action. Corrections remain separate from the source animation.

Scope & limitations

For compatible humanoid FK rigs with Mixamo bone names, including the Tripo Mixamo profile. It is not a universal retargeter for custom rigs or IK controls. See the GitHub guide for setup and compatibility.
